positionHistory.description: The sequence contains the game root and every position after each played move, including the current position. Search appends and removes line-local child positions.
positionHistory.positionIdentity: Board::same_position (move number excluded; board, hands, and side to move included)
positionHistory.rootValidation: the final history position must equal the search root

adjudication.fourfoldRepetition: the fourth occurrence ends the game
adjudication.perpetualCheck: over the interval from the first through the fourth occurrence, if exactly one side gave check after every one of its moves, that checking side loses; otherwise the result is a draw

enteringKing.rationale: Shogitter currently defines no Anhoku jishogi rule; 27-point declaration may be added only in a later version

adjudication.maximumPly: a terminal result produced by the move on the final allowed ply takes precedence over maximum-ply-capped

scoreOrientation.perpetualCheckerLoss: -MATE_SCORE + ply when the side to move is the loser, otherwise MATE_SCORE - ply

transpositionTable.identity: board hash mixed with the ordered inclusive history hashes, side-to-move, check-state, and history length
transpositionTable.requirement: identical layouts reached through different histories must not share entries

nodeLimitedSearch.reason: preserve the frozen combined alpha-beta plus qsearch node budget

dfpnBudget.selection: only a completed mate proof may select a root move; unknown, no-mate, skipped, deadline, or node interruption falls through to searched alpha-beta
